tools.name: get_catalog_overview
tools.description: Coverage of the Gingerguide catalog: number of cities, sights and countries, supported languages, and the exact values accepted by the category, interests and periods filters of the other tools. Call it first when unsure whether a city or filter value is supported.

tools.name: search_cities
tools.description: Find covered European cities by name (in any of the six languages), country or region. Returns the city id needed by the other tools, sight count, summary and web guide URL. Omit query to list all cities.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List covered countries with the ids of their cities.

tools.name: recommend_destinations
tools.description: Suggest covered European cities that fit a traveler's interests or favourite historical periods, e.g. "best cities for Byzantine history" or "a city break for art and food in Spain". Ranks cities by how many of their sights match, and says why.

tools.name: compare_cities
tools.description: Compare two to four covered cities side by side, e.g. "Porto or Lisbon?" or "Seville vs Granada for Moorish history". Gives each city's sight count, days needed, strongest interests and historical periods, share of indoor sights and headline sights, says which city is stronger for each interest or p

tools.name: find_day_trips
tools.description: Day trips from a base city to other covered cities and towns nearby, e.g. "day trips from Florence" or "a day trip from Munich for castles". Ranks destinations by distance, fit with the traveler's interests and periods, and fame, and lists what to see there in one day. Distances are straight-line; t

tools.name: get_city_guide
tools.description: One city's guide: overview, headline sights, lesser-known sights, and every sight with category, coordinates, visit minutes and a one-line description. Set detail to "full" to add the long description of every sight (large response).

tools.name: search_attractions
tools.description: Search individual sights across all cities or within one city, by free text, category, interests, historical period, indoor/outdoor, visit length, free entry or distance from a point. Example: five Byzantine sights in Istanbul, Gothic churches in Spain, or free things to do in Rome. Returns name, de

tools.name: get_attraction
tools.description: Full details for one sight: long description, a notable fact, photo, coordinates, map links, visit minutes, and the nearest other sights with walking minutes. Use the attraction id from search_attractions or get_city_guide.

tools.name: get_visit_info
tools.description: Practical facts for visiting one city: best months and crowd seasons, climate, annual events that change a visit, how to get from the airport, main station or cruise port to the centre (typical minutes), city passes, which sights are free, which need booking ahead, weekly closing days and dress code

tools.name: find_nearby_attractions
tools.description: Sights closest to a latitude/longitude (for example the traveler's hotel or current position), sorted by walking time, optionally filtered by interests or category. If nothing is within the radius, returns the nearest covered city.

tools.name: recommend_attractions
tools.description: Personalized picks in one city for a traveler's interests, favourite periods, preference for headline sights or hidden gems, indoor or outdoor, and time available. Each pick says why it was chosen. Use plan_walking_tour instead when the traveler wants an ordered route.

tools.name: plan_walking_tour
tools.description: Build an ordered self-guided walking route in one city that fits a time budget, e.g. "a two-hour historical walk in Rome". Picks sights by interests, periods and style, orders them to keep walking short, and returns each stop with walking minutes, suggested time on site, clock times and a Google Map

tools.name: plan_trip_itinerary
tools.description: Multi-day plan for one city: each day covers one or two walkable areas (with a public-transport hop between them), ordered as walking routes, plus sights that did not fit. Example: "three days in Vienna for art and music lovers".

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_cities, search_attractions · Public sink: compare_cities.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_cities, search_attractions · Public sink: compare_cities

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_cities" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find Gingerguide cities by name or country. Returns matching cities with their sight count and web guide URL. Omit query to list all." → after: "Find covered European cities by name (in any of the six languages), country or region. Returns the city id needed by the other tools, sight count, summary and web guide URL. Omit query to list all cities."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
